title: Low-temperature deployment-aligned on-policy PPO smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Using the same sharpened stochastic policy for hero behavior and PPO likelihoods will move training state visitation and action credit closer to the substantially stronger greedy execution contract while retaining stochastic exploration and exact on-policy ratios.
material_change: Add default1 hero policy temperature to train_v5 inference and trinal PPO. For hero sample mode, both behavior log-probabilities and PPO current/reference distributions divide legal logits by the same positive temperature; opponents, raw stored weights, legal masking, critic, deployment greedy argmax, and default behavior remain unchanged. Unit-test T1 equivalence, behavior log-probability, and low-temperature concentration, then run one matched T0.5 smoke reusing the audited T1 control.
baseline: Standard10 greedy fresh20k -11.4275 versus sampled T1 -48.9778; two local argmax objectives were stable but nonpositive. Counterfactual Action-Q and single-teacher imitation routes have negative external/generalization evidence.
source: Standard10 initialization and fixed learned-opponent adaptive league; prior source-KL-only T1 control SHA d806394b reused without rerun.

result.summary: Reused the audited T1 control, trained one matched T0.5 treatment for10,705 new physical hands, and evaluated6,144 new common-deck greedy hands. Audit and17 tests passed. Pooled treatment-control was +3.518 bb/100,95%CI[-17.253,24.289], with2/3 positive anchors.
result.conclusion: Using a matched low-temperature behavior and PPO distribution is mechanically valid and produced the first positive cross-anchor direction among three deployment-alignment smokes. The estimate is imprecise and Standard10 point direction remains mildly negative, so this is evidence for a larger matched internal learning-curve pilot only, not Slumbot.
result.next_step: Run a matched approximately65k-physical-hands-per-arm corrected-v6 T1 versus T0.5 pilot with archived checkpoints and untouched larger common-deck multi-anchor evaluation. Preserve the current smoke artifacts and do not allocate Slumbot unless the larger gate confirms broad positive direction.
